objective.name: infer.fake
objective.description: Fake inference provider: answers according to scripted rules instead of a model.

#root.role: Match the received inference request against the scripted rules and return the rule's decided output as a canonical inference response.

transformation_contract.morphing: An inference request becomes the canonical response decided by the first matching scripted rule.
invariants: The first rule whose conditions all hold is selected.
No applicable rule is an error: the fake never improvises an answer.
Every request is recorded in llm_calls before the answer is returned.
The answer carries the decided output unchanged in response.output.content.
failure: The script matter is missing or invalid.
The selected rule asks for an error.
notes: Executed by the test_tools Python wrapper. Test infrastructure only: it carries no business logic and exists to exercise the agentic mechanics.

effects.llm_calls: Appends the request summary and the matched rule to the llm_calls matter.
